title: Florida House, District 66
what_it_does: Represents District 66 (Part of Hillsborough) in the Florida House; votes on state laws and the state budget.
verified_ballot_note: Candidate list taken from the Florida Division of Elections, 2026 general election candidate list on 2026-09-18 (https://dos.elections.myflorida.com/candidates/CanList.asp); statuses Qualified/Unopposed only. Counties from the Legislature's district listings. Positions have not been researched yet.

candidates.name: Traci Koster
candidates.photo_source: Ballotpedia candidate photo (downloaded copy in assets/photos)
candidates.occupation: Attorney; state representative for District 66 since 2020
candidates.background: Northwest Hillsborough attorney first elected to the Florida House in 2020. She has been named a Rising Star by Super Lawyers, led the Hillsborough County Bar's Young Lawyers Division and co-founded Tampa Bay Pro Bono Partners. Mother of two.

roster_sources.title: Florida Division of Elections, 2026 general election candidate list

property_tax.summary: Voted yes on HJR 1-F in the June 2026 special session, which placed Amendment 3 on the November ballot to raise the homestead exemption for non-school property taxes to $150,000 in 2027 and $250,000 in 2028 and to limit how counties and cities may spend property-tax revenue.

sources.title: Florida House roll-call vote, CS/HJR 1F (Save our Homes from Excessive Property Taxes), passage 75-26

immigration.summary: Voted yes on SB 2-C (2025), which created the State Board of Immigration Enforcement, required state help with federal detainers, barred driver licenses for unauthorized immigrants, and funded an Unauthorized Alien Transport Program.

sources.title: Florida House roll-call vote, SB 2-C (Immigration), passage 85-30

guns.summary: Voted yes on HB 543 (2023), which allows carrying a concealed firearm without a state license.

sources.title: Florida House roll-call vote, CS/HB 543 (concealed carry without a license), passage 76-32

education_choice.summary: Voted yes on HB 1 (2023), which removed income limits and enrollment caps so state scholarship funds can follow any K-12 student to private or home education. Her issues page also pledges to protect the Hope, Gardiner and Bright Futures scholarship programs.

sources.title: Florida House roll-call vote, CS/CS/CS/CS/HB 1 (universal school-choice scholarships), passage 83-27

candidates.name: Jose A. "Dante" Sanchez Sanchez
candidates.occupation: U.S. Air Force Reserve veteran; utility/technical professional per his platform
candidates.background: U.S. Air Force veteran whose campaign platform cites technical expertise, military discipline and professional utility experience. His website frames the campaign around God, family and community and a six-point plan on insurance, traffic safety, schools, water infrastructure, veterans and energy.

roster_sources.title: Florida Division of Elections, 2026 general election candidate list

insurance.summary: His platform mixes state intervention with market measures: expanded state-backed My Safe Florida Home hardening grants tied to mandatory premium reductions, plus a crackdown on litigation fraud he says inflates claims.
insurance.quote: We must tackle the root cause of premium spikes by expanding state-backed mitigation grants and aggressively cracking down on third-party litigation fraud

sources.title: Jose 'Dante' Sanchez Sanchez HD 66 platform (campaign PDF)

growth.summary: He says growth without infrastructure is a recipe for failure and would require utilities to expand treatment capacity in proportion to newly approved developments.
growth.quote: Growth without infrastructure is a recipe for failure.

sources.title: Jose 'Dante' Sanchez Sanchez HD 66 platform (campaign PDF)

energy.summary: He backs an all-of-the-above strategy that expands commercial solar, battery storage and smart-grid technology, with state tax exemptions for solar and protection from punitive utility fees.
energy.quote: Expanding commercial solar, battery storage, and smart-grid technologies ensures our grid won't buckle under soaring demand while lowering utility bills

sources.title: Jose 'Dante' Sanchez Sanchez HD 66 platform (campaign PDF)

veterans.summary: He proposes expanding property-tax exemptions for disabled veterans, licensing reciprocity for military spouses and state-funded community veteran mental-health networks.
veterans.quote: We must expand state property tax exemptions for disabled veterans, build stronger mental health networks, and support military spouses

sources.title: Jose 'Dante' Sanchez Sanchez HD 66 platform (campaign PDF)

other_issues.title: Schools
other_issues.summary: He proposes forensic audits of school facility funds, retention bonuses for veteran teachers and expanded trade and dual-enrollment programs.

sources.title: Jose 'Dante' Sanchez Sanchez HD 66 platform (campaign PDF)
